title: Unit Event — Lead to Shine More — Episode8 New Resolve

meta.Event Outline: With more work offers coming in for MORE MORE JUMP! than they can fulfill, Haruka and the others have a serious talk about their work priorities moving forward.

rows.Line: One month later
MORE MORE HOUSE

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: <Next, we have the segment you've all been waiting for. “The Town Revitalization Team!”>

rows.Speaker: MC
rows.Line: <This week, we have MORE MORE JUMP! giving the town of Hanamioka a big hand.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, your segment's about to start!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Th-The stage needs so many planks of wood! We're never gonna finish carrying these over!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Normally, I'd tell you to quit complaining and keep working, but having to make round trips on this mountainous road is pretty draining.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <But this seems like the perfect time for a...! Happy Heave-Hooo!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
<W-Wait...!
That's the technique that allows someone to use their full strength despite being really exhausted! Only truly happy idols can use that!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Every time I've used it, I've been able to get through a shoot no problem! So, let's get back to carrying these planks!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <Okay, I'll do my best!>

rows.Speaker: Local C
rows.Line:
<Besides, this is our town.
That means it's our duty to act.>

rows.Speaker: Local A
rows.Line: <Right. What we mean to say is...>

rows.Speaker: Local A
rows.Line: <Let's do this, together.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
<...!
Thank you very much.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
<Congratulations on finishing!
If you like, please take this commemorative bookmark.>

rows.Speaker: Runners
rows.Line: <Wow, this is so cute! It's like a little flower field!>

rows.Speaker: Runners
rows.Line: <Hehe. It's just like what we saw while we were running.>

rows.Speaker: Runners
rows.Line: <And the food was so good. We've gotta visit again sometime.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
<...!
Thank you for saying that!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Th-That was so good...!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Yes, it was! And I was so moved when the locals came to help you girls.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Me too. The way your earnestness reached them, and they came to help you out... It was so exciting to see!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <So, how did everyone watching react?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, about that... We didn't see that big a response online, since the program's viewership tends to be older...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But we received a ton of fan mail.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: As in, letters?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, on top of those who made posts online, there were many who went out of their way to send you their thoughts on paper?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. They said things like, “I was encouraged by the way you worked so hard for them,” or “I wanted to show my support,” which made us really happy.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The program's ratings aren't actually all that high, but we feel that we spread hope to those who did watch.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And I think we deserve a pat on the back, considering how happy all the locals were.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: E-Everyone, I have big news!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Big news, Saito?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: The director for “The Town Revitalization Team!” just asked me about all of you...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Apparently, they're putting another show into development, and they want you on as regulars!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wh-What...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-In other words...
Another show's in development?
And they want us as regulars?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's not other words at all!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: It is a late-night slot, but it's for a big network!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What?! A big network?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's incredible news, but why?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
So, it wasn't just us being contacted.
People have apparently been sending in an abnormally high volume of messages to the show!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: They want more of MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: And it's not just that. The director also said they'd personally love to work with you again.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I quote, “Getting the footage we wanted was obviously important, but considering how happy you made all the locals, we couldn't have asked for a better shoot.”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's so wonderful to hear such high praise.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! That means we managed to live up to the director's expectations!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And we have you to thank, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree. You took the time to make sure we'd choose an offer that would be perfect for our dream...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Even while we were shooting, you placed the locals first and made all the right decisions.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! You made it a show that everyone, from the staff to the viewers, really enjoyed.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We can't thank you enough, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: All your effort has allowed us to take another big step forward as a group.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: All of you...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thanks.
I just tried to do what I could, but I'm really glad you're all saying this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
By the way, Haruka.
I have a little idea...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: How would you feel about becoming the producer for MORE MORE JUMP!?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You mean...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course, I'm not saying that you'll have to do everything. We'll still discuss anything that's really important as a group.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But with everything that happened this time around, it got me thinking. We'll have to be careful about how we keep on moving forward...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We need a producer to find that way for us, and keep pulling us in the right direction.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And you're the only person who can do that, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You were the lead for an A-list idol group, which means there are certain things that only you can see.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(The producer of MORE MORE JUMP!
That's a big responsibility...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (If I take on that role, then my decisions will have a direct impact on our group's future...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'd also like to ask you to do this, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Not only are you experienced and knowledgeable, you're perceptive and careful. Your calls have saved us so many times.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, she's right.
I'd be more than happy to follow you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If you do accept, we promise to come up with ideas for streams and practice in your place... And we'll always be ready to help if you're in trouble!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: All of you...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (They really believe in me.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Then, I don't want to let them down. Also...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, I'll do it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-You will?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. The truth is, I was also starting to feel that we need a dedicated producer.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, I couldn't be happier that my idea ended up helping MORE MORE JUMP! this much...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Now I want to keep coming up with ideas that will help us shine.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I want to reach even greater heights with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I don't honestly know how good a producer I'll be as I am now... I'll have to start learning.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure you'll do great, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'll probably be asking you a lot of questions moving forward too, Saito. So, if you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Of course!
I'll learn everything I can, and support you in every way!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(I have to really do my best here.
In order to make sure MORE MORE JUMP! shines brighter and brighter.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (So that we become top idols who are able to spread hope to everyone in Japan.)
Talent Agency

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Hello, Mr. Hiiragi.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
Ah, hello.
Quick question. You said something about “What's the Buzz?” looking at our idols for their list of up-and-comers...

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: What's going on with that?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: A-About that... I checked with them, and they decided to give that spot to another group...

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line:
I see.
I was really hoping to lock that down.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
I'm sorry...
It sounded like they were really eager to get MORE MORE JUMP! in, given how popular they're getting.

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: MORE MORE JUMP!, huh?
